The '''Seekers for Truth''' are [[Seanchan]] who investigate treason and other wrong-doing. They act as spies among the Seanchan and their enemies, and are akin to a secret police force. They are ''[[so'jhin]]'' and the personal property of the Empress. Seekers wear a tattoo of the Imperial Raven and Tower on the back of each shoulder, though they are less willing to show them off than the [[Deathwatch Guards]] with their own tattoos.{{ref/book|4|38}} Seekers also carry identification plaques for when the need arises.

Anyone must obey the Seekers of Truth, even one of the Blood.
